liveness.probe: save state; 120 frames RIGHT vs 120 frames LEFT; compare 2KB RAM
liveness.oam_note: Pool exposes no peek_oam in this build; OAM proxy = RAM $0200-$02FF sprite-shadow (OAM DMA source page)

verification_fresh_pool.method: new Pool, load_worker_state(state file), 120f RIGHT vs 120f LEFT from same snapshot
verification_fresh_pool.visual: frame renders confirm side-scrolling gameplay: player vehicle moves and camera scrolls right under RIGHT, vehicle pins to left wall under LEFT

caveats: pause check inconclusive: 120f RAM churn 38 unpaused vs 55 after START press; START may open an animated subscreen rather than a hard freeze. Primary liveness evidence is the input-divergence probe + visual frames.

Pool.step_all tuples are (frame, preprocessed, ram, done) 4-tuples; with set_skip_preprocess the preprocessed slot is an empty (0,0) sentinel — RAM is index 2 (a first probe pass diffed the sentinel and read false zeros).
